title: Gnazvor hunt
description: A Marauder holds station in the Gnazvor and raids Hauvnok's shipping lanes. Prove yourself to the Hauvnok office (standing 0.20) and put it down.

title: Lucidite contract
description: Hauvnok pays a premium on 500 m³ of lucidite out of the Kvonice belt. Standing 0.20 required before they hand out the order.
